live.instructions:
Read-only AliExpress server (market FR, EUR). 8 tools; none writes, orders and payments are blocked.
Pass the whole list in one call, never loop. A rating or review count of 0 from AliExpress means unknown (null, listed in z): get_reviews is authoritative.
- get_products: 1-10 products, compact; with:[skus,freight,reviews,age,wholesale,media,description,raw]; compare:true for 2-8 copies.
- get_sku_matrix: variants, true labels (sku_attr after '#'), EUR price, stock.
- get_freight: shipping per SKU; fee_eff = fee paid at the SKU price; without sku_ids it reads the SKUs 20 at a time.
- get_media_snapshot: supplier media inventory; receipt_urls gives byte receipts; view shows up to 8 images to you.
- search_text, search_by_image: find products and other suppliers of the same product.
- get_reviews: summaries for 1-10 products, or pages of one.
- aliexpress_call: any other read-only AliExpress method; method "docs" for the official spec, "status" for token and quota.
compact:true gives columnar answers with the same facts. An answer with next was cut by the per-call budget: call again with next. On error follow next_step, retry once, then report.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Compact records for 1-10 AliExpress products: title, status, Choice, sales, rating, EUR price and stock ranges, attributes, store, package, lead time, voltage and description evidence (CE, smart, battery, mains). with adds blocks: skus, freight, reviews, age, wholesale, media, description, raw. compare:true (2-8 ids) gives one table with the cheapest shipping.

with.description: Blocks to add per product. raw = the upstream payload (large).

compare.description: 2-8 copies of one product side by side (reads freight).

sku_ids_by_product.description: Freight SKUs per product; default the first 20 from sku_offset.

max_review_pages.description: Review pages the age block may read.

review_before_date.description: ISO date: the age block stops once a review this old is seen.

tools.name: get_sku_matrix
tools.description: Variants of one product: options, true labels (sku_attr after '#', the supplier's real label), EUR price, stock, voltage per SKU and label_integrity. Use it to pick the SKU IDs that get_freight needs.

full.description: Keep empty values the default cleanup drops.

compact.description: Columnar answer (cols + rows, option names once): same facts, about 5x smaller.

lang.description: Language of option and attribute names (en for DSers plans).

tools.name: get_freight
tools.description: Real shipping options for 1-20 SKUs of one product: carrier and service code, delivery days, cost, free shipping, Choice free-shipping threshold (pfs, thr) and the fee actually paid at the SKU price (fee_eff). Without sku_ids, reads the product's SKUs 20 at a time from sku_offset (sku_next). Ships to France by default.

sku_ids.description: SKU IDs taken from get_products or get_sku_matrix.

include_raw.description: Keep each SKU's raw AliExpress answer.

compact.description: Options once (opts) and one row per SKU and option: same facts.

sku_offset.description: Without sku_ids: first SKU to read.

fresh.description: Skip the 10-minute cache of successful answers (failures are never cached).

tools.name: get_media_snapshot
tools.description: Supplier media inventory of one product: gallery, SKU images, description images, video posters, buyer photos (review_pages) and the image of each option value. receipt_urls (up to 50, alone or with product_id) returns byte receipts: sha256, size, format, dimensions.

receipt_urls.description: AliExpress media URLs to download and fingerprint.

compact.description: Without the supplier_images union (rebuilt from the four lists).

view.description: Up to 8 AliExpress image URLs answered as images (220 px thumbnails), e.g. to compare two photos.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Product reviews. Without pages: page-1 summary for 1-10 products (review count, rating, observed date range, photo count). With pages: those pages for a single product, review text included.

pages.description: Specific pages; requires a single product.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: AliExpress keyword search (fr_FR, EUR), up to 5 pages in parallel (100 candidates). Columnar answer: id, title, image, the SKU behind the price, category path, EUR price, orders, rating %, score, type. Applies no business threshold.

pages.description: Pages read in parallel from page (20 items each).

sort.description: orders and comments sorts need category_id.

category_id.description: AliExpress category; required to sort by orders or comments.

min_orders.description: Keep items with at least this many orders (no extra call).

search_extend.description: AliExpress searchExtend, e.g. [{searchKey:'item_tag', searchValue:'choice'}]; whether AliExpress applies it is unproven.

tools.name: search_by_image
tools.description: Other suppliers of the same product, from an image URL. Default = the raw AliExpress answer (prices in cents, evaluate_rate 0-5, sorted by sort_type). compact:true = sorted by similarity, prices in euros. product_id instead: its factory family, each hit read and proven (5 shared photo files or the very same picture score, same declared maker or video owner; options reported); factory_shops = proven distinct stores; copies = hits the stock robot can switch to (same photos or picture, same variants and category, Choice); both lower bounds when complete is false.

product_id.description: Instead of image_url: the factory family of this product.

n.description: Items to return (family: 10 read at most).

tools.name: aliexpress_call
tools.description: Read-only escape hatch: signs and calls any AliExpress method not covered above. method "docs" (params {q} or {method}) returns the official spec; "status" the token, quota and cache state. Orders, payments, token and write methods are refused before signing. Answers unwrap *_response and list wrappers, keep request_id and empty strings, replace description HTML by a marker; pick paths like "result.ae_item_sku_info_dtos[].sku_attr"; over max_chars, too_large gives the size of each key instead of cutting.

method.description: e.g. aliexpress.ds.category.get, or docs, or status.

params.description: Business parameters; objects and arrays are sent as JSON.

pick.description: Paths to return instead of the whole answer.
